text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the homeowner of 134 Rykert Crescent requesting access from the property's home to the pool enclosure area in the rear yard remain without a fourth fence. The pool enclosure does not meet the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences. (Table #1 for violation deficiency and By-law section).
That consideration of the item be deferred until the September 13, 2021 meeting of the North York Community Council.
